work.description: Paul VI's encyclical of 24 June 1967 on priestly celibacy, AAS 59 (1967) 657-697. It confirms the Latin law while denying that celibacy is required by the nature of the priesthood, sets out christological, ecclesiological, and eschatological reasons of fittingness, treats the Eastern discipline, and at n. 42 opens the possibility of admitting married ministers of separated communions to priestly functions.
